body_markdown:
Remember the days of exchanging friendship bands? Those times were special. But now, simply forwarding a WhatsApp message doesn’t do justice to your strong bond with your friends.


We have a better way to say thank you to your buddy this Friendship Day! **From August 2nd to 8th, invite your friend to join Mudrex, and we’ll send them a Bitcoin on your behalf.**


This Friendship Day, invite your friend to the world of crypto. Together, you can grow a portfolio as strong as your bond! 💜


[Refer Now](https://mudrexmobile.page.link/refer)


P.S. You will also continue to earn a 50% commission on the transaction fees every time your referred friend buys or sells a coin on Mudrex.


### **Earn more by reaching more people, Share on Twitter (X) to spread the word!**
